{{Top}}
The '''Magrody Institute of Programmable Intelligence''' was the organization that [[Paldis Doxin]] belonged to in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==History==
It was founded by [[Nasdra Magrody]] and involved with [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]] research at the time. [[Nichos Marr/Legends|Nichos Marr]] later was the premiere [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|AI]] programmer there. [[Cray Mingla]] and [[Stinna Draesinge Sha]] were also members. It had around 150 pupils, many of whom were tapped by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] for employment at the [[Maw Installation]]. The Emperor also consulted the institute for help in designing the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].

The Institute also created [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implants.
